links.outcome: Model calibration and discrimination across retraining cadences over 5-year simulation
links.effect: Weekly retraining AMDBE 2.57 (AUROC 0.843); monthly AMDBE 2.73 non-inferior; longer intervals showed progressive calibration degradation (p<0.001); static model AMDBE 10.6 in 2024 vs 1.79 weekly.
links.quote: Monthly, or more frequent, model retraining sustains discrimination and calibration for paediatric ED admission prediction.

links.outcome: Model performance across periodic retraining schedules versus no retraining
links.effect: Static model AUROC fell from 0.852 in 2019 to 0.799 in 2024 and AMDBE rose from 2.73 to 10.6; weekly retraining held AUROC 0.851 to 0.838 and AMDBE 2.47 to 1.78.
links.quote: Performance drift was more pronounced in calibration than discrimination metrics, as AUROC for the static model declined from 0.852 in 2019 to 0.799 in 2024, whereas AMDBE rose from 2.73 in 2019 to 10.6 in 2024.

links.outcome: Effect of retraining/recalibration frequency on miscalibration after population and data drift
links.effect: Retraining weekly to monthly kept AMDBE 2.57-2.73; longer cadences up to static reached AMDBE 3.5-7.7 mean; static calibration intercept moved from 0.034 to 0.321.
links.quote: In contrast, longer cadences allowed drift to accumulate, resulting in miscalibration and predicted operational error.

links.outcome: Data, concept and covariate drift in static model over time
links.effect: Domain-classifier AUROC 0.92-0.99 for 2022-2024 vs training window; static model AMDBE rose to 10.6 in 2024, systematic underestimation of demand.
links.quote: Such drift resulted in systematic underestimation of demand, which, without retraining, could have negative operational implications for bed management, surge preparedness and flow planning.

links.outcome: Whether discrimination metrics conceal calibration degradation
links.effect: Static model AUROC declined modestly (0.852 to 0.799) while AMDBE rose from 2.73 to 10.6; AMDBE showed variability even when AUROC appeared stable.
links.quote: AMDBE expressed more concept drift than traditionally reported measures such as AUROC, sensitivity and specificity.

unlisted_practices: Cost-effectiveness analysis of retraining cadence (computational burden vs performance)
Performance-triggered adaptive retraining based on drift threshold
